next_source_leaf: Compose bind_campaign_character_npc_events_v101(record,input,error) with the same CampaignFsmV101 and retained host/level/object owners, then invoke the original record.services.npc_script callback. teardown: After source class unpublication, CanonicalCharacterCandidateFactoryV60::erase_after_unpublication(identity,error) calls record.close_after_unpublication before erasing its retained record. The owning process path is SourceProcessObjectsV121::flush(require_quiescent,error), which delegates the actual ordered ObjectManager lifecycle to CanonicalObjectManagerV1::flush_source_v1; this lifecycle runs target-list flush, object delete, AI pointer cleanup, class D0 and source-unpublication retirement before clearing its containers. The required quiescence callback remains caller-owned.
